title: Agent Component Schema
description: Schema for a HarnessKit agent, extending the base component schema.

summary.description: Short description of what the agent does

source_refs.description: References to external sources this agent depends on or is derived from

source_id.description: source_id referencing an entry in the source registry

path.description: Path within the source that was used

used_for.description: What this source reference was used for

owned_files.description: Files within this repo that are owned by this agent

targets.description: Target AI platforms this agent is adapted for, keyed by platform name

additionalProperties.description: Build configuration for a single target platform

output_path.description: Path where the built agent is written for this target platform

review_state.description: Current review state of the agent

upstream_sync.description: Status relative to upstream source changes

type.description: Primary role type of this agent

domains.description: Domains this agent is responsible for

tool_policy.description: Tool usage policies for this agent

default.description: Default tool policy when not explicitly configured

model_policy.description: Model selection policy for this agent

token_efficient.description: Model tier for cost-sensitive or high-volume operations

normal.description: Default model tier for standard operations

max.description: Model tier for complex or critical operations

output_schema_ref.description: Reference to the JSON schema that defines this agent's output shape
